chapter: Family follow-ups from the first reels
title: Drake and Walker and the Whitman Sisters shows
summary: Royal describes these traveling black variety shows, and how his father's band backed them in Texas and nearby states.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Okay, and you mentioned that in Texas, when I believe you said your father's band played for shows that would come through and you mentioned Drake and Walker and the Whitman Sisters, you identified them as among the better live black shows, but what else can you tell me (inaudible)?

Well, those were traveling shows. They traveled all over the country. That is, when I speak of all over the country, I mean the states East of the Rockies, on from the deep South to the far North and into Canada. Drake and Walker was a show -- Drake and Walker, they were both excellent singers at that time and they danced and they had variety shows. They had singers and dancers with them, as well as comedians and they did comedian type work also.
And they would carry their music with them and find a band (inaudible)?

That's correct. They would have a nucleus at times, where they would, as some shows do in this day and age, which would consist of a piano player, a drummer and maybe one other instrument, whatever it happened to be. When my father traveled with them sometimes as their band when they were in his territory and he would probably do the whole

tour and barnstorming through Texas, Oklahoma and Arkansas and maybe some parts of Missouri and Kansas, probably no further than that. By the same token, the Whitman Sisters also was a road show and they traveled and had, at that time, they carried some of the -- whoever were the better entertainers that would go on the road at that time, traveled with the Whitman Sisters -- dancers, singers and some musicians. They would put on a complete show if they would come into town and they would put on a complete live show, consisting, like, of a three-hour performance.
Do you remember the names of any other acts (inaudible)?
Not really. That's rather hard. I was just a little guy then.
